WITH target_tenants AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM tenants
  WHERE name IN ('Kibblewick','Studio Vrij','Petalcourt Beauty','Marrowby & Vane','Cragsley Outfitters','Ampfeld Elektronik')
),
cart_population AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.tenant_id, c.currency_code, c.subtotal, c.item_count, c.status, c.created_at, c.converted_at
  FROM carts c
  JOIN target_tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
  WHERE c.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
cart_with_eur AS (
  SELECT cp.*,
    CASE WHEN cp.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN cp.subtotal
         ELSE cp.subtotal / er.rate END AS subtotal_eur
  FROM cart_population cp
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
    AND er.quote_code = cp.currency_code
    AND er.as_of = CAST(cp.created_at AS DATE)
),
tiered_carts AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN subtotal_eur < 50 THEN '<€50'
      WHEN subtotal_eur < 100 THEN '€50-100'
      WHEN subtotal_eur < 200 THEN '€100-200'
      ELSE '€200+'
    END AS price_tier,
    CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_converted,
    CASE WHEN status = 'converted' AND converted_at <= created_at + INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resolved_1h,
    CASE WHEN status = 'converted' AND converted_at > created_at + INTERVAL '1 day' AND converted_at <= created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resolved_1_7d
  FROM cart_with_eur
),
tier_totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carts FROM tiered_carts
),
tier_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    price_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cart_count,
    AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count,
    SUM(is_converted) AS converted_count,
    SUM(resolved_1h) AS resolved_1h_count,
    SUM(resolved_1_7d) AS resolved_1_7d_count
  FROM tiered_carts
  GROUP BY price_tier
)
SELECT
  ta.price_tier AS price_tier,
  ta.cart_count AS cart_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * ta.cart_count / tt.total_carts, 2) AS pct_of_total_carts,
  ROUND(ta.avg_item_count, 2) AS avg_item_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * ta.converted_count / ta.cart_count, 2) AS overall_conversion_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * ta.resolved_1h_count / ta.cart_count, 2) AS pct_resolved_within_1_hour,
  ROUND(100.0 * ta.resolved_1_7d_count / ta.cart_count, 2) AS pct_resolved_in_1_7_days
FROM tier_aggregates ta
CROSS JOIN tier_totals tt
ORDER BY
  CASE ta.price_tier
    WHEN '<€50' THEN 1
    WHEN '€50-100' THEN 2
    WHEN '€100-200' THEN 3
    WHEN '€200+' THEN 4
  END
note: I did not have the exact wording of the "prior cart-timing reports," so I defined conversion/resolution the standard way: overall_conversion_pct = share of carts with status='converted'; pct_resolved_within_1_hour = share converted within 1 hour of created_at; pct_resolved_in_1_7_days = share converted strictly between 1 and 7 days after created_at (carts converted in the 1-hour-to-1-day gap are not double-counted in either bucket). Please flag if the prior reports used different cutoffs.
